install._default_role_note: HESTIA_ROLE is launch context, never config: the seat loader refuses it from the vault projection, so the hook line is the only place a default can live. deploy/register-members.py renders it as a pass-through, HESTIA_ROLE="${HESTIA_ROLE:-<this>}", on the gate and witness lines, so a launcher that knows better (a mesh fire, a watcher unit) still overrides it. The value is what this seat registered by hand before the reconciler (dp 2026-10-06).
install._companions_note: #1373: a companion is a file no harness registers but a registered hook calls from its own directory; install-members.sh installs it into the directory the named hook was installed to, with the same backup and verify, and records it in the manifest.
